data.name: Manus Domini
data.detailed_description:
Welcome, Architect... Your task is simple: Shape history to our liking.

Start shaping your empire from a small pre-historic tribe working your way through antiquity and the middle ages to a modern metropolis. Or aim further into a utopian or dystopian future. Guide multiple nations with your invisible hand through eras of peace, wealth or war, all to further the goal of complete world domination. But pay attention you are not the only power seeking control.

Don't make us regret choosing you...

Sculpt your Past and Future:

You control multiple nations simulationsly. Whether these nations trade, share or fight is up to you and your skill as an architect.

You might create a simplistic theocracy, futuristic metropolis, orwellian surveillance state or even a perfect utopia - if such a thing even exists - but what counts most is that you always follow the instructions of Manus Domini.

But don't let your guard down: You aren't the only one trying to influence history from the shadows...

Research and Build your Way through Eras:

Start out as a simple neolithan tribe and progress through centuries of development and inventions.

Research new technologies through a complex technology tree system and share your knowledge with other nations... or of course don't.

Seize Control of the World:

Expansion will ultimately make you step on other peoples feet.

Lead armies of strong fighters or stealthy intruders through enemy territories and seize their empires.

But don't get ahead of yourself maybe establishing a simple trade route wouldn't be such a bad idea.

Whether through diplomacy, trade or war you will ultimately leave a mark on history.
